theme: A wide-open day, kids at home
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is genuinely open today — nothing booked until an 11 AM Brunswick call tomorrow — so it's a rare chance to clear the few time-sensitive things that have been drifting.

acts.line: A rare open morning — nothing on the calendar until tomorrow, so the day starts entirely on your terms.
The calendar stays clear straight through; the middle of the day is unclaimed.
The girls are with you and Mike tonight, with tomorrow's late-morning Brunswick call the only thing on the horizon.
